title: Insurance Act 18 of 2017
verified_how: Fetched the gov.za page. Commencement: 1 July 2018 (GG 41735, GN 639). It 'replace[s] certain parts of the Long-term Insurance Act, 1998, and the Short-term Insurance Act, 1998'. The repeal of LTIA ss 48, 52, 53, 56, 59, 60 and STIA ss 46, 47, 51, 53, 54 was excluded from that commencement. Amended by Act 23 of 2021. The Gazette PDF says 'English text signed by the President'.
notes: Prudential regulation and microinsurance. It replaced the prudential parts of the STIA and LTIA, which remain in force for market conduct and policyholder protection (policyholder protection rules).
